reason: I already pay a bookkeeper to sort the receipts every month, so this solves a problem I don't personally feel. If the bookkeeper wanted it I might pay, but I'm not going to set up another tool myself.
objection: Half our site receipts are faded or handwritten Indonesian nota. If the bot gets them wrong, someone still has to check every row, and then I'm paying for the bot and the bookkeeper both.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper telling me it cuts her monthly hours and her fee, after testing it on our real messy site receipts from the Telegram groups.
